notes.title: Full Release Mega Update v1.08
notes.content:
[b]After one year in development and another half a year in early access, let me present you the final update before full release:[/b]

[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] Radar that shows enemies around you
[*] New maps (20 missions total)
[*] Timed leaderboards for each level
[*] Sounds for chest opening for each rarity
[*] 4 new weapons
[*] Save reset option
[*] Auto fire option
[*] End game boss
[*] Auto kill enemies when stuck
[*] Achievements (34 to start with)
[*] Music player now loads your own music to play in-game (from C:/Users/yourName/Music/VoidRangers)
[*] Supports mp3, ogg, aiff & wav
[/list]


[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Armor max level increased to 100
[*] Removed second endless level
[/list]


[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Critical damage from explosions (rockets etc)
[*] Double damage & Double score unique modifiers
[/list]

Once again let me say [b]Thank you![/b] to the awesome community for the best feedback and ideas!

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27148436/4f8e11645b7372b1c359ecde891c3ed11a009e63.jpg[/img]

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*]new map (see it on level 5)
[*]new ground enemies & bosses (creatures)
[*]cap on bullet hits effect (improves performance for fast weapons)
[*]cap on dmg numbers (improves performance for fast weapons)
[*]auto sell options to sell mission rewards of specific rarities
[*]double click on sell button to directly sell weapon
[*]more variation for current end game weapons
[*]option to turn on/off shadows (improves performance)
[*]3 new unique properties for rare and legendary weapons each in 2 versions
[*]random map rotation to Galaxy Vortex, endless levels
[*]9 new music tracks
[/list]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed top score to support scores above 1 000 000 000
[*]fixed top score level names
[*]improved scene borders for droids on several levels
[/list]

[h1]Others:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated to the newest version of steam vr (improves performance)
[*]Adjusted difficulty curve (the game is easier now)
[/list]

Thanks all for awesome feedback & ideas!

There are a lot of things that I wanted to add, but they didn't make it, even through I reworked them several times, e.g.: better way for rich players to buy higher tear/rank weapons, better audio+visual clues about incoming fire etc.. Those will be taken care of in the upcoming updates.
